feeds.title: Angela Porter
feeds.description: Angela Porter is an Artist, Illustrator and Author. Much of her work is abstract with flowing shapes, lines and colours that create crazily textured and detailed artworks.

feeds.title: Azreenchan
feeds.description: I'm Azreen. I'm an illustrator & graphic designer. This blog is on the doodle, places, events, little things, little stories, experiences, lessons, thoughts, quotations, the knowledge that matters to me.

feeds.title: Johanna Basford Blog
feeds.description: Johanna Basford is an illustrator and ink evangelist who prefers pens and pencils to pixels. She's on a mission to make the world a happier and more creative place through her coloring blog she shares her latest Coloring artworks, collaborations, printable downloads, and many more informative articles.

feeds.title: Living A Creative Life with Melissa Dinwiddie Blog
feeds.description: Melissa Dinwiddie's mission is to catalyze your happiness by empowering you to find and follow your calling, create your art and share your work because that's how you will change the world! Feeding your creative hunger is one of the fastest routes to happiness.

feeds.title: KBB Blog
feeds.description: Kate Bingaman-Burt is an illustrator and educator. Her work explores consumption, collaboration, and exchange.

feeds.title: Doodle Lovely
feeds.description: DOODLE Lovely is about taking a moment to wander, to pause, to slow it down and soak it in. During an artful calm you will be greeted with clarity, and then surprised with confidence!

feeds.title: Desisoul Arts
feeds.description: Desisoul Arts includes artsy journey strewn with art, interviews of wonderful artists, tidbits from rich cultural legacy as well as few spiritual and enlightening moments!! Author Shilpa Rajeev would love to share with you the techniques she learns along the way and also learn new stuff from the others.

feeds.title: Doodle Addicted
feeds.description: If you need modeling portfolio images, commercial fashion images, portraits, or food photography, Doodle Addicted has got you covered.

feeds.title: The Doodle Daily Blog
feeds.description: The Doodle Daily' is the official blog for Tjomies Vintage Stationery.With emphasis on the the original hand drawn works that we have created over the years.
